title: 401(k) Statement

origin.publisher: Voya Financial, recordkeeper for the Publix Super Markets, Inc. 401(k) SMART Plan
origin.title: 401(k) SMART Plan Statement, January 1 to March 31, 2023
origin.clearance_note: A real participant's quarterly 401(k) statement for the Publix Super Markets, Inc. 401(k) SMART Plan, administered by Voya Financial. It was saved to PDF from Safari on an iPhone and uploaded to Scribd under the title 'Safari', and was downloaded manually, because Scribd blocks scripted requests. Scribd is not the publisher, so the document is treated as a personal record. The participant's name (on every page), home street address, city and ZIP, and employee number were replaced with document-types/scripts/redact.py, which removes the underlying text rather than covering it; the PDF metadata was cleared. The plan, sponsor, recordkeeper, balances, funds, contribution rates, payroll location code and the two scanned plan-sponsor inserts (pages 6 and 7) are kept as printed; none identifies the participant once the name, address and employee number are gone. Verified: no original value is extractable from the committed PDF, no other line of text changed, and none appears anywhere in this collection folder.

redactions.note: The original values are deliberately NOT recorded here. The rules file used by redact.py stays outside the repo.

replaced.with: a plausible random stand-in, keeping the leading zeros (scripts/plausible.py)

notes: The request named no page or fields. Following the lending framing used for the bank and HELOC statements, page 1's featured fields are the ones a lender reads when verifying retirement assets: the participant, the plan, the account value (the closing value in Your Total Account Value) and the quarter's employee and employer contributions. The participant is the stand-in name. plan_sponsor was tried first but grounds to the whole orange panel, the sponsor banner together with the Account Balance History chart, so it was swapped for the participant. The large account value in the orange banner is not used because account_value grounds to a neighbouring block; the closing value in the summary table carries the same figure. The summary reconciles: 11,412.38 + 542.08 + 572.87 + 1,122.69 = 13,650.02. The period dates read OFF only because they are normalized to ISO dates. Pages 6 and 7 are scanned images of plan-sponsor inserts; the parse reads page 6's fund performance table as a table. preview_pages shows the summary, holdings, account activity and the scanned performance page.
